title: CP asymmetry and visible decay in $3+1$ neutrino oscillations on a quantum computer
summary: We use quantum simulation to study how visible neutrino decay modifies the vacuum CP asymmetry in muon-to-electron oscillations within a $3+1$ neutrino scenario. The decay channel preserves CP symmetry, with CP violation arising from phases in the mixing matrix. We track the energy redistribution from visible decay and distinguish how parent attenuation and daughter regeneration modify the CP asymmetry.
